de.sqlite: the app's offline German dictionary, built by tools/make_dictionary.py.

Word data: Wiktionary (https://en.wiktionary.org), German entries as extracted by kaikki.org
(https://kaikki.org/dictionary/German/). Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 and GFDL.

Word frequencies: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave (https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords),
built from OpenSubtitles 2018. Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

This database is a derived work and is shared under the same license (CC BY-SA 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
